text:
Jenna Morales: Quick heads-up — PraxisAI interview locked in for Tue 2026-04-07 10:00am PT. Need: final customer quote (one short para), logo permission, and legal signoff on embargo.
Arjun Patel: Can we align this with the Apr 14 webinar? If we tee the case excerpt in the webinar promo, should drive signups. :thinking_face:
Lina Gomez: CS checked — Praxis is ok with a single external quote and logo use, they want to see the final copy first. They also handed a metric: “~45% latency reduction when migrating to dedicated inference.” Need to confirm consent to publish that number.
Tom Becker: Drop the draft here and I’ll do a quick legal sweep. Any contractual NDA items? Embargo date requested?
Jenna Morales: Draft here: https://docs.google.com/.../praxisai-launch-draft (permissions open to redwood-marketing). They asked for an embargo until Apr 9 but marketing wants Apr 7. We should pick one.
Lina Gomez: Praxis contact said Apr 9 is preferred (end of their quarter). Can we compromise — internal release Apr 7, public press Apr 9? They asked for a short approval window (48 hrs).
Arjun Patel: That works — we'll plan webinar promotion for Apr 14, email push Apr 10, social teaser Apr 9. Need the final quote by EOD tomorrow to lock creative.
Tom Becker: Read draft — nothing big contract-wise. Two small asks from legal: (1) change “massively improved” to “measurably improved”; (2) confirm the 45% stat source + timestamp. Also legal wants explicit written permission for logo + quote from Praxis — can be Slack confirmation from their PM or an email.
Jenna Morales: Thanks Tom. Lina, can CS get written confirmation for logo + quote from Praxis PM? Also please confirm the metric source (duration/measure). I’ll update wording to “measurably improved.”
Lina Gomez: On it. Priya (CS lead) pinged their PM, they responded: "confirming permission for logo and quote; metric measured on production traffic over 2 weeks ending 2026-03-20." Putting their short confirmation into the doc now.
Arjun Patel: Cool — once we have written permission, can we also get a 1-2 sentence customer blurb that we can use in the webinar slide deck? If Praxis gives that, we’ll add them to the speaker slide.
Jenna Morales: Added their confirmation to the doc and swapped language. Tom — can you re-check the small edits? Link: https://docs.google.com/.../praxisai-launch-draft#final
Tom Becker: Rechecked. Edits look fine. Legal approves with the written confirmation included. Embargo: legal recommends Apr 9 public, internal embargo Apr 7 is fine but we should not share externally before Apr 9. Marking approved.
Arjun Patel: Great — locking calendar for webinar promo. @growth-team please hold Apr 9–14 for Praxis co-promo. :raised_hands:
Lina Gomez: Praxis also offered a 5–10 minute quote video clip. Decide by EOD if we want it; need to schedule a 20-min recording session.
Jenna Morales: Let's take the clip — would make a nice social asset. Arjun, can you coordinate recording logistics? I'll send a calendar invite for the interview + 20min recording.
Arjun Patel: Yep — will schedule recording for Apr 2 9am PT and add a 20-min buffer. Also will draft CTAs for the webinar landing page that reference the case metric.
Jenna Morales: Awesome — final checklist: quote + logo permission (received), legal approval (received), recording scheduled (Arjun), webinar assets (in flight). Anyone else need to weigh in?
Tom Becker: All good from legal.
Lina Gomez: CS good. I'll monitor the final quote signoff during recording.
Jenna Morales: Thanks all — will post final launch timeline in #marketing-calendar once recording time confirmed. :tada:
